messages:
Maria V: Kicking off handoff for Acadia's dedicated capacity bring-up. Need final quota plan + load template. ETA today?
Devon L: I can pull the quota numbers, Maria. Current commit is 600k token/min, right? We should request a 20% buffer.
Taylan R: Confirmed. Also want autoscale thresholds: warmup target 70% GPU util, panic threshold 92%.
Nate S: For the smoke load tests, we'll run two profiles: steady-peak (80qps, 2s p50) and spikey (200qps bursts). I'll post the k6 scripts.
Maria V: @Nate can you paste the k6 snippet? We'll add that to the runbook.
Nate S: Sure —

```bash
k6 run --vus 100 --duration 5m load/steady.js --out json=steady.json
k6 run --vus 300 --duration 2m load/spike.js --out json=spike.json
```

Nate S: Logs will be in /tmp/acadia-load-<env>.json (ops-bot will archive)
Jenna C: Quick note from success: customer wants canary shift at 2pm PST, small % first, watch latency tail.
Devon L: I'll update quota request to 720k token/min and add note about pinned model v2.1.2.
Taylan R: Autoscale policy to include cooldown 90s and fallback route to hosted gpt-3.5-compat if node errors.
Maria V: Risk check — renewal signal is good but we can't afford a premature throttling event. Add a rollback plan.
Nate S: Rollback plan: route 30% traffic to hosted, notify SRE channel, and scale down warmup after 10m if errors >1%.
ops-bot: archived attachment: /artifacts/acadia-load-templates/steady.json (uploaded by Nate S)
Maria V: Great — final checklist: 1) quota request submitted (Devon) 2) k6 jobs scheduled (Nate) 3) autoscale policy deployed (Taylan) 4) customer notified + canary (Jenna). Can we close by 13:30 PST?
Devon L: On it, submitting now. (reaction :thumbsup:)
Jenna C: I'll confirm canary window and coordinate enablement doc with the customer.
Taylan R: Will deploy policy and post policy ID in thread when done.
Maria V: Thanks team — ping me once all items are green and Ops will trigger the run. :rocket:
